title: 第十三章 爆兵
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“话说博士啊，那小鬼看样子要在这里住不少时间。”渚琰·工藤新一佯装不知道柯南就躲在自己的身后发呆，向阿笠博士提起了柯南：“他上学怎么办？看他的年龄也该上个一年级了吧？”

“说的也是。”阿笠博士点点头，现在在他眼里，柯南就是一个不知为何知道的有些多的小鬼，多半还是离家出走。

离家出走的事情可以让他多逍遥一会，但学还是得上的：“我明天就去给柯南办理文件，让他转学到帝丹小学吧。”

柯南：啊？让我去上学？

“还有啊，养着这小鬼得花不少钱啊。”工藤新一又说道：“博士刚刚也听到了，这小鬼还吵着要穿新衣服。”

“咳。”阿笠博士干咳一声：“新一啊，等柯南的父母从国外回来了，我就让他们支付柯南的生活费。”

这小鬼的学费我垫了，生活费就由你来垫一下吧。

工藤新一目光向下，瞥了一眼脚边懵瞪的柯南，嫌弃的摇摇头。

工藤新一到了医院之后，第一个项目就是把绷带拆开，备皮、重新给伤口清洗、上药、包扎。

当清晰的见到那沾着血的伤口时，一旁的柯南下意识摸了摸后脑勺。

他见过各种各样的尸体，像摔烂的西瓜一样四分五裂的也见过，但还是第一次见到这样的伤口长在‘自己’的身上。

昨晚当他以小孩子的身体醒来时，头上的伤口已经几近愈合。游乐园的保安帮他打了绷带，但他到家就把绷带拆了，小兰都不知道他头上受了伤。

而工藤新一后脑勺上的伤，柯南看了也得承认，看起来好疼的样子。

“医生。”小兰更是心疼的都泛着泪花了，又忍不住问道：“新一他自从被打了脑袋后，就总是说些奇怪的话，会不会是伤到脑子了？”

工藤新一：……

“不会的。”虽然是外科医生，但好歹读书的时候把蓝色生死恋都学全了，医生一边上药一边安慰小兰：“主管性格的是前额叶，在额头下面这一块。你男朋友受撞击的地方是枕部，是不会波及前额叶的。至于胡言乱语，也许是受到了惊吓，休息一段时间就好了。”

小兰不是很认同这个结论，尤其新一的胡言乱语基本都是在调戏她，怎么看也不像受到惊吓，更像是小说里写的那种脑袋受伤就性情大变。

医生看出来了小兰不放心，又补充道：“如果真的伤到了前额叶，他会出现一些脑损伤症状的，比如短暂失忆、昏迷、呕吐、抽搐、手脚无力、说话不清，小伙子一项都没有吧？”

小兰脸色一白：“新一确实昏迷了一段时间。”

柯南又一次摸了摸自己的脑袋：难道自己也被那一棍子打成脑损伤了？

“有昏迷史？”医生一愣。

他好歹也有十多年的处理经验了，通常能够造成脑损伤的伤势，至少要严重到发生颅骨骨折并凹陷的程度。而手里这个伤口……长6cm纵行不规则裂伤，创缘欠齐，深达帽状腱膜下层，创周软组织轻度肿胀，压痛明显，未触及明显颅骨凹陷性骨折及骨擦感。周围头皮未见明确缺损、撕脱，颈部活动无明显受限。

说人话就是，看着没那么严重。

难道是被‘高手’打的？有内伤？

之前说不会那是为了安抚家属情绪，现在作为医者的谨慎就不应该也不可以给出绝对性的回答了。

“别着急，他可能造成了一点脑震荡，不一定会严重，不过你们接下来该去神外科就诊了。”普外医生一边安慰着小兰，一边把这个皮球踢了出去。

工藤新一又来到了神经外科，当然，脑CT的结果是并没有颅内出血、挫伤或水肿，毕竟渚琰·工藤新一头上的伤是渚琰·小黑人打出来的，根本就没到把他打至昏迷的程度，更没有内伤。

不过脑震荡无法通过常规影像学直接查出，既然没查出别的问题，医生直接给工藤新一按上了脑震荡的诊断结果。

因为在名义上被喂下了可疑的毒药，工藤新一的下一站是门诊采血室做血常规检验。

路上，经过一个拐角时。

"Speaking of Doctor, that brat looks like he will live here for a long time." Nagisa and Kudo Shinichi pretended not to know that Conan was hiding behind him in a daze, and mentioned Conan to Dr. Agasa: "What should I do if he goes to school? Judging from his age, he should be in the first grade, right?"

"That's right." Dr. A Li nodded. In his eyes, Conan is just a kid who knows a lot for some reason and has probably run away from home.

The matter of running away from home can allow him to relax for a while, but he can still study: "I will go to Conan to apply for the documents tomorrow and let him transfer to Didan Elementary School."

CONAN: Huh?Let me go to school?

"Also, it costs a lot of money to raise this kid." Kudo Shinichi added: "The doctor just heard it, and this kid is still clamoring for new clothes."

"Ahem." Dr. Ali coughed dryly: "Shinichi, when Conan's parents come back from abroad, I will let them pay for Conan's living expenses."

I've paid for this kid's tuition, and it's up to you to pay for his living expenses.

Kudo Shinichi looked down, glanced at the stunned Conan at his feet, and shook his head in disgust.

After Kudo Shinichi arrived at the hospital, his first task was to remove the bandages, prepare the skin, clean the wound again, apply medicine, and bandage it.

When he clearly saw the bloody wound, Conan subconsciously touched the back of his head.

He had seen all kinds of corpses, including ones that were torn apart like a smashed watermelon, but this was the first time he had seen such wounds on his body.

When he woke up in a child's body last night, the wound on his head had almost healed.The security guard at the amusement park put a bandage on him, but he took it off when he got home, and Xiaolan didn't even know he had an injury on his head.

As for the injury on the back of Kudo Shinichi's head, Conan had to admit that it looked very painful.

"Doctor." Xiaolan was so distressed that she burst into tears, and couldn't help but ask: "Xinyi has been saying strange things since he was hit on the head. Could it be that he has injured his brain?"

Kudo Shinichi:......

"No." Although he is a surgeon, he has learned all about the blue life and death love when he was studying. The doctor comforted Xiaolan while giving medicine: "The prefrontal lobe is in charge of personality, which is under the forehead. The place where your boyfriend was hit was the occipital area, which will not affect the prefrontal lobe. As for the nonsense, maybe he was frightened, so just rest for a while."

Xiaolan didn't quite agree with this conclusion, especially since Shinichi's nonsense was basically teasing her. It didn't look like he was frightened, but more like the kind of temperament changes in novels where a head injury occurs.

The doctor could tell that Xiaolan was worried, and added: "If the prefrontal lobe is really injured, he will have some symptoms of brain damage, such as short-term memory loss, coma, vomiting, convulsions, weakness in hands and feet, and unclear speech. The young man has none of these, right?"

Xiaolan's face turned pale: "Xinyi was indeed in a coma for a while."

Conan touched his head again: Could it be that he was also brain-damaged by that stick?

"Do you have a history of coma?" The doctor was stunned.

After all, he has more than ten years of experience in dealing with injuries that can usually cause brain damage, at least severe enough to cause skull fractures and dents.As for the wound on my hand... it was a 6cm long longitudinal irregular laceration with uneven edges and deep to the subgaleal aponeurosis. The soft tissue around the wound was slightly swollen and tender, and there was no obvious depressed skull fracture or bone abrasion.There was no clear defect or avulsion in the surrounding scalp, and there was no obvious restriction in neck movement.

To put it bluntly, it doesn't look that serious.

Was he beaten by a 'master'?Any internal injuries?

I said no before just to appease the family members. Now as a doctor, I am cautious and should not and cannot give an absolute answer.

"Don't worry, he may have a little concussion, it may not be serious, but you should go to the neurosurgery department next." The general surgeon comforted Xiaolan and kicked the ball out.

Kudo Shinichi came to the neurosurgery department again. Of course, the result of the brain CT showed that there was no intracranial hemorrhage, contusion or edema. After all, the injuries on Nagisa Yan and Kudo Shinichi were caused by Nagisa Yan and the little black man. They were not to the extent of beating him to a coma, and there were no internal injuries.

However, concussion cannot be directly detected through conventional imaging. Since no other problems were found, the doctor directly diagnosed Kudo Shinichi with a concussion.

Because he was nominally fed a suspicious poison, Kudo Shinichi's next stop was the outpatient blood collection room for routine blood tests.
